primaryChecks.text: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned away from them, and didn’t destroy them;
primaryChecks.previousContext: ‘If evil comes on us—the sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine—we will stand before this house, and before you (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.’
primaryChecks.nextContext: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 「セイル山」が明記される。アンモンやモアブの集団名と並ぶが、山地そのものと住民を同じ対象にはしない。

primaryChecks.text: When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the LORD and give praise in holy array as they go out before the army, and say, “Give thanks to the LORD, for his loving kindness endures forever.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 敵対勢力の列挙に「セイル山」が再び明記される。

primaryChecks.text: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them. When they had finished the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy each other.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah; and they were struck.
primaryChecks.nextContext: When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 「セイルの住民」は地域名から派生する住民表現として関連する。住民集団を地形そのものと同一視しない。

excludedCandidates.text: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.
excludedCandidates.reasonJa: 「セイルの子ら」は住民集団を指す表現で、山地そのものの明示ではないため、この地理プロフィールの用例から除外する。

excludedCandidates.text: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.
excludedCandidates.reasonJa: 「セイルの子ら」は集団名であり、この節は神々を指す。地理的なセイル山地の用例としては数えない。

wikipediaRead.title: Mount Seir
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事は死海とアカバ湾の間の山地をエドム北西部に位置付け、ヨシュア記15:10の北方の同名地と区別する。2 Chronicles 20:22–23も住民・集団の用例として挙げる。

articleBodyReview.identityCheckJa: 固定WEB 2歴代誌20:10はセイル山をアンモン・モアブと並ぶ名として挙げる。記事はエドム北西部の南方山地とヨシュア記15:10の北方の同名地を区別する。
articleBodyReview.geographyCheckJa: 記事の地理説明は死海とアカバ湾の間、エドム北西部。広域山地の正確な境界は一点に定めない。
